title: Français 23054 — Spanish numerical correspondence
contents: Philip II discusses Ottoman negotiations, aid to Transylvania and the Emperor, and the conversion of Condé’s mother. An earlier letter reports the capture of Hulst and payments to the army.
status: 3/3 pages transcribed in part; 3/3 pages deciphered in part
fields: Historical interlinear plaintext on f145r, in this volume.
Published Cp.39 reconstruction from a different volume, Français 15972 (Cryptiana). ·

excerpt: **…que no se les puede dar, y assi sera de la prudencia de S.S. embiar al legado y a Juan Francisco las ordenes convenientes de los socorros que deven hazer en este año con el Emperador y el transilva**[no]**.**
translation: …which cannot be given to them. Thus His Holiness should prudently send the legate and Juan Francisco the appropriate instructions for the assistance they are to provide this year with the Emperor and the Transylvanian [ruler].
